terms.title: Terms & Privacy Policy
terms.section1Body:
CoopGrid ("Platform", "hum", "hamar") par raua sabke swagat ba. CoopGrid mobile applications ya iske centralized administration interfaces ke download, install ya istemaal karke, raua ("User", "Employer", "Worker", "Kisan", "Vyapari") ekaun Terms and Conditions se kanooni roop se badhae khatir sahmat hotaani. Agar raua ekaun shartan se sahmat naikhee, ta raua ke turante app ke istemaal band karke eke uninstall kar deve ke chaahi.
Ekaun sharta raua ke hyperlocal on-demand service matching, kheti ke machinon ke kiraya aur kheti ke surplus utpadan ke matching services ke istemaal ke govern karela.
terms.section2Title: 2. DUAL INTERFACE IDENTITY AUR PROFILE VERIFICATION
terms.section2Body:
Account Authenticity: Users ke ekgo chalu mobile number se register kare ke hoi jekar multi-factor validation (OTP check) zaroori ba. Raua aapna account ke sabhi activities khatir khud zimmedar bani.
Verification Protocols:
Gharalu/Vyaktigat Accounts: Sarkari pehchan patra jaanch (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, ya Driving License check) ke adheen ba.
Sansthan/Corporate Accounts: Certified regulatory data jaise GSTIN, Udyam Aadhaar number, ya valid cooperative federation license del zaroori ba.
Cooperative Workers: Sahi aur jaanchne yogya Labour Cooperative Federation membership badges aur registration upload kare ke hoi.
Right to Terminate: CoopGrid Administrators ke paas galat documents ya jhoothi location deve wala accounts ke freeze, reject, ya permanently delete kare ke poora adhikar ba.
terms.section3Title: 3. SERVICE DECOUPLING KE PRAKRITI AUR "INFORMATION-ONLY" MATRIX
terms.section3Body:
Hyperlocal Matching Mechanics: Standard services khatir, CoopGrid ekgo on-demand proximity routing network ke tarah kaam karela, jo khareeddaron ke karigaron ya asset owners se jodal karela.
Agrifood Marketplace Disclaimer: Bulk kheti ke surplus faslon aur raw yields ke vyapar khatir, CoopGrid sirf ekgo matchmaker aur decentralized information node ke roop me kaam karela.
Financial Disclaimers: CoopGrid visibility, contact links, aur dynamic location routing pradan karela. Platform bulk crop trades khatir koi financial transaction, escrow system ya payment settlement process nahi karela.
Off-Platform Transactions: Baad ke sabhi cash payment, quality check grading settlement, weight measurement aur commercial pricing trades Farmer aur Buyer ke beech seedhe offline hola. Offline sauda bhala par CoopGrid kisi bhi tarah ke kami, quality me kharabi, galat wazan ya payment me deri khatir zimmedar nahi hoi.
terms.section4Title: 4. ON-DEMAND ROUTING, BIDDING, AUR EMERGENCY SOS MECHANISMS
terms.section4Body:
The Bidding / Expression of Interest Flow: Regular postings khatir, employers aapna service requirement broadcast karele. Paas ke registered workers aapna interest submit karele. Aakhri chunav transparent peer ratings ke aadhar par Employer ke hoi. Jin workers ke skip kail jala, u broadcast kail gail job par koi claim nahi kar sakat.
Emergency Flash Bookings (SOS): Emergency SOS system ke istemaal kare par, Platform ekgo automatic allocation system laagu karela. System employer selection screen ke bypass karke local area ke sabse pehle responder ke project assign kar dela. Urgent requests ke dauran users ekaun automatic assignment model ke swaekar karele.
terms.section5Body:
Asset Safety: Provider App par machinery (tractors, tillers, harvesters) list kare wala kisan e guarantee dele ki machinery sahi se kaam kar rahil ba, surakshit ba aur legally registered ba.
Operation Liability: Hirer (Employer App user) surakshit operation protocols khatir zimmedar ba. CoopGrid hardware damage insurance, mechanical breakdown guarantee, ya replacement funding pradan nahi karela.
terms.section6Title: 6. WORKER WELFARE, MINIMUM WAGES, AUR CODE OF CONDUCT
terms.section6Body:
Fair Wage Compliance: Employers kshetriya cooperative guidelines aur local government dwara tay kail gail kanooni baseline minimum wages ke paalan kare khatir vachanbaddh baani. CoopGrid aisan applications ke reject karela jo aarthik shoshan karele.
Mutual Respect Rating: Sabhi users ke Dual Rating System ke tehat evaluate kail jala. Feedback database me abuse, safety hazards, physical mistreatment ya jaanboojhkar payment na kare ke report milal par user ke grid se turante ban kar del jai.
terms.section7Body:
Service Limitations: CoopGrid software services ke "As-Is" aur "As-Available" aadhar par pradan karela. Hum complete network blackout me bina rukawat ke local operations ke guarantee nahi deti, bhale hi active local database caching features majood hoke.
Liability Boundaries: Lagoo kendriya aur kshetriya kanoon ke haad tak, CoopGrid, iske regional administrators, cooperative society partners aur software development teams kisi bhi sharirikh chot, kheti ke nuksaan, aarthik nuksaan, fasal kharab hoke ya cargo movement me hoke wala dikkat khatir zimmedar nahi hoihe.
terms.section8Body: Hamar paas kisi bhi samay in sharton ke badle, adapt kare ya poori tarah overhaul kare ke poora adhikar ba. Text updates ke baad bhi platform ke lagataar istemaal naye updated Terms and Conditions ke automatic validation ke darshawela.
